descripcion_geo: Mountainous region east of the Arabah, between the Dead Sea and the Gulf of Aqaba. Inhabited by the Edomites, descendants of Esau.
importancia_estrategica: Land of Esau / Edom; control of the southern caravan routes.

historias.descripcion: Esau moves to the mountains of Seir with his family and flocks; there he founded the Edomite nation.

historias.titulo: The dominion of the leaders of Seir
historias.descripcion: Esau's descendants reign in Seir: the Edom king list predates the Israelite monarchy.
God orders Israel not to provoke the Edomites of Seir because they are 'sons of Esau, your brother.'

personajes.descripcion: He settled in Seir and was the father of all the Edomite tribes.
The Horites inhabited Seir before the Edomites; Esau displaced them.
He prophesied against Seir/Edom for his betrayal during the fall of Jerusalem.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Sister Earth of Israel (Esau and Jacob); his pride and betrayal at the time of Jerusalem's fall brought about Obadiah's prophecy.

mitos.nombre: Seir: the land of the enemy brother

judaismo.descripcion: Seír/Edom represents the brother who becomes an enemy; their arrogance will be humbled (Abd 1:3-4).
judaismo.significado_teologico: Seír/Edom represents the brother who becomes an enemy; their arrogance will be humbled (Abd 1:3-4).
